incident-bot: pagerduty alert fired: PD#PD-20260314-1176 — service=llm-serving, rule=high-cpu-90, urgency=high. Triggered at 2026-03-14T02:01:05Z. Primary on-call: Alex P. Incident link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-20260314-1176
Alex P: ugh — I didn't hear anything, my phone was on DND. can someone ack if it's urgent?
incident-bot: Escalation timer: primary not acknowledged after 10m → paging secondary: Maya R.
Maya R: ACK. seeing cpu at 95% on llm-worker/g4-03, GC stalls and KV cache growth. jumping into logs and tracing now. joining bridge https://meet.example.com/llm-ops
Alex P: I just woke up, no push came through. my PagerDuty shows "push suppressed (mobile DND)". I'm on the train without VPN, won't be able to run commands. sorry.
PagerDuty: Escalation fired: Manager escalation path active after 20m without start of remediation. Manager Lin (Manager) paged.
Lin (Manager): I'm up — joining bridge. ping me for handoff.
Maya R: Rolling restart on the problematic replica to drop KV cache and free GPU memory. running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/llm-worker --selector=instance=g4-03
kubectl -n prod get pods -l instance=g4-03 -o wide
```
Carlos G: noted — is there a runbook link? /cc @Alex P for variance in escalation timing.
Maya R: runbook: https://internal.docs/llm/ops/high-cpu. performing drain+restart now. ETA ~6m.
incident-bot: command output:
```
pod/llm-worker-g4-03-7xq2 restarting
pod/llm-worker-g4-03-9pv4 restarting
OK: pods restarted, new pods in Running state within 90s
```
Maya R: CPU on g4-03 down to 42% across replicas, request latency returning to normal. I'm keeping it monitored for 10m.
Alex P: thanks — sorry about the DND. action item: I'll tweak my PD contact methods and enable SMS for primary during nights.
Lin (Manager): thanks @Maya R. quick ask: why did manager escalation fire despite secondary ACK? can we avoid waking managers when remediation has started?
Maya R: looks like the escalation policy is based on "incident not acknowledged OR remediation not started" and PD didn't register our remediation start because we didn't mark a step in PD. I'm going to add a quick note in PD when we start remediation so it stops manager escalation.
Carlos G: filing a follow-up ticket to adjust policy thresholds and add a check for active remediation in PD webhooks. ticket: INT-2026-0423 https://tracker.internal/INT-2026-0423
Alex P: proposed config changes: 1) increase primary->secondary timeout to 12m, 2) add SMS for primary overnight, 3) add a PD webhook event when remediation begins to suppress manager escalation.
Lin (Manager): agreed. assign owners and include postmortem checklist.
Maya R: marking incident resolved in PD. resolution note: rolling restart of llm-worker replica recovered KV cache; CPU normalized.
incident-bot: Incident resolved in PagerDuty: PD-20260314-1176 at 2026-03-14T02:43:00Z — duration 42m.
Alex P: postmortem: will write a short blameless writeup and include timeline + PD policy change proposal. assigning to Alex P and Carlos G.
Lin (Manager): thanks team. small ops follow-ups: verify SMS config and add a single-button "start remediation" action in PD to avoid false escalation. :thumbsup:
Maya R: noted. closing thread after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
